title: Great way to see Barcelona
text: Max was a wonderful tour guide. We stopped at lots of the main attractions and had a wonderful time exploring the city.  Highlight of the trip so far
author: Jake E

title: Highlights of Barcelona without having to walk!!!
text: Great tour. Second time I have used this company. Max our guide was great. I highly recommend!
author: Overlordsmith

title: Fantastic Segway tour experience!
text: We had a great time with Max on our Segway tour. He took time to make us feel comfortable with the segways as we were novices! They were surprisingly easy to manoeuvre though and we really enjoyed whizzing through the city. He was very informative and we learned a lot along the way. It was my husband’s birthday so he took us up to the mountain top as a special treat which had amazing views of the city. Loved the whole experience!
author: Inspire41562446278

title: Great way to see Barcelona
text: Pablo was an excellent guide and very informative but also fun! There were 6 in our group altogether and we covered a large area in 2 hours with some interesting stops along the way. I would definitely recommend this segway tour of Barcelona.
author: greycat123

title: Great way to explore the City
text: Max was great, he was very knowledgeable and patient. He made the tour interesting and fun! It was a nice small group, so easy to stay together.
author: Helen A

title: Segway is a wonderful way to see the sights
text: This was a wonderful tour of the old town, beach and waterfront. Pablo was a great guide with lots of knowledge and tips. Highly recommended.
author: LouisK1966

title: Brilliant way to explore Barcelona - and so much fun!
text:
Thanks Max for an amazing Segway tour. We saw so many sites around the city whilst learning about it's history. Max made the tour fun and exciting with his quick wit and interesting tales.  We have been to Barcelona many times and wanted to do something a little different- this is definitely the most fun you'll have. 
Great value for money- I would highly recommend it.
author: janeto67

title: Great experience
text: Amazing tour, was very much fun! Would 100% do it again and recommend it to my friends and family! A great mix of historical facts and a lot of fun with the Segway.
author: mandya217

title: Great Tour!
text: Max was a great guide, very professional and mindful of our abilities. We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and would definitely recommend the tour.
author: Paradise144759

title: Fantastic!! This should be the first thing you do in Barcelona!!
text:
We had an absolutely fantastic experience with Sun & Segway Barcelona – easily one of the highlights of our time in the city!

Our guide, Danni, was superb from start to finish. Not only was he incredibly friendly and personable, but he was also impressively knowledgeable about the history, culture, and hidden gems of Barcelona. His commentary was the perfect balance of informative and entertaining, and he made sure everyone in the group felt comfortable, safe, and engaged throughout.

We got the hang of the Segways in a nearby skate park just a short walk from the Sun & Segway office – a safe
